<h2>Prepare sjSDM Tuning Folds</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Prepares every repeat/fold partition exactly once for reuse by granular
candidate work items.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_sjsdm_tuning_folds(
  data_assignments = NULL,
  prepare_fold_function = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Cross-validation assignments accepted by
[run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prepare_fold_function">prepare_fold_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable preparation function documented by
[run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>List with one keyed entry per fold. Each entry contains fold context,
preparation timing, and either the prepared inputs or a structured error.
</p>

</main>
